text:
Kate: Heads-up — need to finalize the refarch validation runbook before we hand to marketplace next week. can we sync on the gating checklist?
Omar: +1. do we have a minimal smoke test matrix? latency/cost/iam/kv-cache behavior?
Priya: I started a doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1REFARCH-VALIDATION (draft) — lists tests, owner suggestions.
Lucas: we need AMI/packer build step added to our terraform modules, otherwise marketplace won't accept the image.
Jin: for inference-specific checks please include kv-cache correctness and perf at 2x and 4x sequence lengths. seen regressions when quantized.
Kate: thinking of three gates: 1) infra/collateral (TF modules + AMI) 2) functional smoke (responses, auth, output shape) 3) perf + cost SLOs. if any fail, block marketplace publish.
Omar: agree. propose minimal terraform check: apply in a sandbox, run smoke, destroy. CI should enforce.
Priya: owners: infra -> Lucas, smoke tests/docs -> me, perf -> Jin, partner sigs + final sign-off -> Omar. ok?
Lucas: ok for infra owner. i'll add packer step and terraform example to the module repo. will also add a basic cloud-init script for logs.
Kate: timeline? we need runbook + CI gates by Thu EOD to hit Friday partner review.
Priya: i'll have the doc fleshed out by Wed EOD. will include checklist and example curl tests.
Jin: i'll provide perf harness and threshold numbers by Thu morning. need access to a small Ampere GPU pool for reproducible numbers. @Lucas can you provision?
Lucas: yes, can carve out a small quota in the partner sandbox. will post creds to vault and add README.
marketplace-ci: Automated message: a minimal CI template is available: https://git.internal/redwood/marketplace/ci-templates. Use the terraform-smoke.yml template.
Omar: quick infra snippet we want referenced in the runbook (minimal):
```hcl
provider "aws" {
  region = var.region
}
module "redwood_refarch" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/refarch-modules.git//marketplace-ready"
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  ami_id = var.ami_id
}
```
Priya: for smoke tests add this curl to validate responses and function signatures: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\  -d '{"model":"rwd-neo-1.5b","input":"Hello"}' | jq '.text'
```
Kate: good. also include a small regression dataset (5 prompts) to assert output tokens and sampling distribution, not just status codes.
Jin: note on perf gating: we run 3 warmup runs, then 20 measured samples. 95th p99 latency must be < 220ms for the small model under batch=1. I'll add exact numbers.
Omar: compliance item: include IAM policy snippet that limits S3 access to the partner bucket and ensures no public snapshot sharing.
Lucas: adding IAM snippet and packer pipeline to the module. will open a PR with descriptions.
Priya: docs: i'll add a checklist section called "marketplace prerelease gate" with items, owners, and required evidences (CI logs, perf csv, AMI checksum).
Kate: decision: if any gate fails, we iterate with partner and re-run the CI job. final sign-off from Omar required before we hit marketplace.
Omar: agreed. please tag me in PRs and the runbook doc. i'll do final risk review.
marketplace-ci: Build hook: terraform-smoke.yml triggered on PR to refs/heads/marketplace-ready.
Kate: action items: Lucas -> PR for packer + IAM by Tue EOD; Priya -> runbook doc + smoke scripts by Wed; Jin -> perf harness + numbers by Thu am; Omar -> final review Fri.
Priya: I'll also add a tiny troubleshooting section (common failures + quick fixes). e.g., 
- "TF apply fails: provider mismatch" -> ensure terraform >=1.5 and pinned aws provider 5.x
- "AMI boot fails: no agent" -> verify cloud-init and systemd service for redwood-agent
Kate: perfect. this is concise enough to copy into the partner kickoff thread. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
Omar: Thanks — will coordinate partner-facing timeline after my review.
Lucas: will post PR link when ready.
Jin: ping me if you need extra perf nodes.
Kate: closing thread, we'll reopen when PRs land.
